title: Graph databases in one idea

kcs.statement: A graph database stores nodes and edges and follows relationships by traversal, so multi-hop queries like friends-of-friends stay fast where SQL would need repeated self-joins.

problem_ideas: Count the self-joins SQL needs for 'friends of friends of friends'
Pick the store for a fraud-ring detector linking cards, devices and addresses
Decide whether a follower count belongs in a graph database
Model 'people you may know' as nodes and edges
Argue against a graph database for a simple follow list read only one hop deep
List two interview prompts where a graph store is a reasonable mention
